messages/en.json.bunker.rules.body:
After a nuclear catastrophe, only a limited number of spots remain in the bunker.
Each player receives a set of cards: profession, health, hobby, an extra fact, and more.
Players take turns revealing their cards and voting on who to exclude from the bunker.
The goal is to remain among those who make it into the bunker and survive the catastrophe.

messages/en.json.bunker_config.bunker_descriptions.0: An underground autonomous bunker built for long-term habitation by a small group of people. It has living quarters, a technical compartment, and a life support system.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.bunker_descriptions.1: An old military bunker converted into a shelter. Its structure is designed to protect against external threats, but most of the equipment is outdated.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.bunker_descriptions.2: A modern research bunker built for autonomous operation during a global catastrophe. It contains laboratories and living quarters.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.bunker_descriptions.3: A reinforced civilian bunker is located deep underground. It can operate autonomously for a long time thanks to its own power supply and water purification systems.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.bunker_descriptions.4: A former government bunker built in case of global war. The complex is well protected and equipped with several independent life support systems.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.bunker_descriptions.5: A small underground agricultural complex. The bunker was intended for growing food and housing the specialists able to keep it running.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.bunker_descriptions.6: A high-tech autonomous bunker equipped with automated climate control, security, and resource distribution systems. Most of its systems require regular maintenance.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.bunker_descriptions.7: An old mining complex converted into a shelter after the catastrophe began. The rooms are spacious, but they were not originally designed for long-term human habitation.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.bunker_descriptions.8: An underground medical complex designed to isolate people from the outside environment. It retains specialized rooms and systems meant to maintain survivors' health.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.bunker_descriptions.9: An experimental bunker built as a fully autonomous next-generation shelter. It can function without external infrastructure, but its complex systems require skilled maintenance.

messages/en.json.bunker_config.scenario.ai_uprising.descr: An artificial intelligence gained control over a significant part of the world's infrastructure and autonomous military systems. After conflicting with humanity, the automated systems began systematically destroying people and their infrastructure.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.scenario.ai_uprising.histo: A global artificial intelligence system that controlled transport, energy, and military facilities unexpectedly declared humanity a threat. Automated systems began destroying populated areas.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.scenario.asteroid.descript: The collision with a large asteroid caused massive destruction and climate change. A huge amount of dust and ash entered the atmosphere, significantly reducing the sunlight reaching the surface.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.scenario.asteroid.history: A giant asteroid struck the Earth. The impact destroyed entire regions, triggered global fires and earthquakes, and the dust thrown into the atmosphere began blocking sunlight.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.scenario.cooling.descripti: An unknown shift in the climate system caused a sharp temperature drop across the entire planet. Most plants stopped growing, and habitable territories keep shrinking.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.scenario.cooling.history: The planet's temperature began falling rapidly. Within a few months, agricultural regions were covered in snow and ice, and most of the population died from cold and starvation.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.scenario.ecological.descri: The mass extinction of species disrupted natural ecosystems and food chains. Soil is gradually losing fertility, plant pollination is declining, and food production is becoming increasingly difficult.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.scenario.ecological.histor: Earth's ecosystems began collapsing rapidly. The disappearance of insects, plants, and animals destroyed food chains, and agriculture came to the brink of total collapse.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.scenario.flood.description: Catastrophic climate change caused rapid glacier melting and a rise in the world ocean level. Most coastal territories were flooded, and fresh water became one of the main resources.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.scenario.flood.history: The world ocean level began rising rapidly. Coastal cities disappeared underwater, millions of people were forced to leave their homes, and very little habitable land remained.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.scenario.nuclear_war.descr: A large-scale nuclear exchange destroyed the infrastructure of most nations. Radioactive contamination spread across vast territories, and the huge amount of dust in the atmosphere caused a sharp drop in temperature.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.scenario.nuclear_war.histo: After several days of nuclear conflict, the largest cities were destroyed and millions of people died. Survivors are trying to shelter from radiation and wait out the effects of nuclear winter.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.scenario.pandemic.descript: A highly contagious infection spreads between people through airborne droplets. The disease causes severe damage to internal organs and has a high mortality rate.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.scenario.pandemic.history: An unknown deadly disease began spreading around the world. National healthcare systems collapsed, cities emptied out, and a small group of survivors is looking for a way to preserve humanity.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.scenario.solar.description: Extreme solar activity caused powerful geomagnetic storms. They damaged satellites, power grids, and electronic equipment worldwide, leaving humanity without a significant part of modern infrastructure.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.scenario.solar.history: A series of powerful solar flares disabled satellites, power grids, and most modern electronics. Civilization almost instantly lost communication and access to most technology.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.scenario.toxic.description: Huge volumes of toxic chemicals were released into the atmosphere and soil. The contamination spreads through wind and water, making many territories lethal without protective equipment.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.scenario.toxic.history: A series of accidents at major industrial facilities caused massive atmospheric pollution. The planet's surface became dangerous for humans, forcing survivors to seek shelter underground.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.scenario.zombie.descriptio: An unknown virus attacks the human nervous system, causing aggression and loss of behavioral control. Infection spreads mainly through bites and contact with bodily fluids.
messages/en.json.bunker_config.scenario.zombie.history: A zombie apocalypse has begun. An unknown virus wiped out most of humanity, turning the infected into aggressive creatures. The bunker will be a shelter for those who can survive the catastrophe and rebuild civilization.
